import pandas as pd

def load_and_prepare_source(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Load a source CSV file and ensure correct dtypes and column order.
    """
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    
    # Enforce schema dtypes as per target schema
    df = df.astype({
        'tripduration': 'Int64',  # Use pandas nullable integer dtype
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',
        'gender': 'Int64'
    })
    
    # Reorder columns to target schema order explicitly
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime',
        'start station id', 'start station name', 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude',
        'end station id', 'end station name', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude',
        'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]
    df = df[target_columns]
    
    return df

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_paths = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]
    
    # Load all sources into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for path in source_paths:
        df = load_and_prepare_source(path)
        dfs.append(df)
    
    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Optional: Remove duplicates if any (not specified but often useful)
    combined_df.drop_duplicates(inplace=True)
    
    # Optional: Reset index after drop_duplicates
    combined_df.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)
    
    # Export the combined DataFrame to the target CSV path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to: {target_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
